choten: extremely long twintails with a pastel PINK and MINT GREEN gradient
long ribbon-like hair strands curling and flowing all around her body
cream / white blonde hair at the crown, a pastel bow and a star hairpin
small heart and star marks on her right thigh
thick platform pastel blue mary jane shoes with ankle straps
overall high-key pastel palette (pink, mint, lavender, cream)
ame: near-black dark twintails, shorter and spikier than Choten, with a small red ribbon
an X-shaped hairpin, front bangs partly covering one eye
a black choker with a red heart charm
overall dark low-key palette (black, crimson, charcoal)

choten.joy: Expression and pose: beaming open-mouth smile, eyes squeezed happily, both arms thrown up in a cheer.
choten.shy: Expression and pose: blushing hard, eyes looking away, both hands pressed to her cheeks, feet turned inward.
choten.pout: Expression and pose: sulking pout with puffed cheeks, eyebrows knitted, arms crossed, looking sideways.
choten.worried: Expression and pose: anxious, worried eyebrows, hands clasped together in front of her chest, leaning slightly forward.
choten.jealous: Expression and pose: jealous, narrowed eyes and a small 'hmph' pout, one hand on hip, the other pointing at the viewer.
choten.sleepy: Expression and pose: sleepy, half-closed eyes, yawning with one hand covering her mouth, the other rubbing an eye.
choten.surprised: Expression and pose: startled, wide eyes and a small open mouth, both hands raised beside her face, shoulders up.
choten.smug: Expression and pose: confident smug grin, one eyebrow raised, finger pointing up as if making a point, chest out.
choten.sad: Expression and pose: teary eyes about to cry, wobbling mouth, hands holding the hem of her skirt, shoulders drooping.
choten.laugh: Expression and pose: laughing out loud with eyes closed, one hand on her stomach, the other waving.
choten.love: Expression and pose: lovestruck, sparkling eyes with tiny heart highlights, making a heart shape with both hands in front of her chest, glowing blush.
choten.thinking: Expression and pose: thinking, looking up to the side, index finger on her chin, other hand on hip.
choten.wave: Expression and pose: friendly greeting, big smile, one arm raised high waving hello.
choten.cheer: Expression and pose: cheering the viewer on, fists clenched at chest level, determined sparkling eyes, big encouraging smile.
choten.pajama: Outfit change: pastel pink pajamas with a star pattern, holding a small plush pillow, sleepy soft smile, hair slightly loose but still twintails.
choten.casual: Outfit change: oversized pastel lavender hoodie and a mint pleated skirt, relaxed pose with hands in the hoodie pockets, gentle smile.

ame.joy: Expression and pose: a rare small genuine smile, eyes slightly softened, one hand loosely raised near her chest.
ame.shy: Expression and pose: blushing, turning her face away with an annoyed frown, tugging at her own twintail.
ame.pout: Expression and pose: sulking, arms crossed tightly, looking sharply away, cheeks faintly puffed.
ame.worried: Expression and pose: worried, brows drawn together, biting her lip, one hand gripping her other arm.
ame.jealous: Expression and pose: jealous glare, eyes narrowed with a faint blush, arms crossed, chin slightly lowered.
ame.sleepy: Expression and pose: sleepy, heavy half-closed eyes, slouching, rubbing one eye with the back of her hand.
ame.surprised: Expression and pose: caught off guard, eyes wide, mouth slightly open, one step back with hands half-raised.
ame.smug: Expression and pose: smug, small mocking smirk, one hand on hip, looking down at the viewer.
ame.sad: Expression and pose: quietly sad, eyes downcast and glistening, hands hanging loosely, shoulders low.
ame.laugh: Expression and pose: a soft laugh escaping, hand covering her mouth, eyes closed, shoulders slightly shaking.
ame.love: Expression and pose: caught being sincere, strong blush, looking straight at the viewer with vulnerable eyes, both hands clutching the hem of her skirt.
ame.thinking: Expression and pose: thinking, eyes closed, arms crossed, head tilted slightly.
ame.wave: Expression and pose: a reluctant small wave with one hand at shoulder height, neutral face with the faintest blush.
ame.cheer: Expression and pose: quietly encouraging, small fist raised at chest level, looking away but with a faint smile.
ame.pajama: Outfit change: black oversized long-sleeve pajama shirt with a tiny red heart print, hugging a dark pillow, sleepy annoyed face, twintails down loose.
ame.casual: Outfit change: black hoodie with a crimson inner lining and a charcoal pleated skirt, hands in the hoodie pockets, indifferent expression.
